privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.description: VoidToInfinite's privacy policy: what personal data we process, on what legal basis, how long we keep it, and how to exercise your GDPR rights.
privacy.intro: This policy follows the two-layer model allowed by article 11.1 of the Spanish LOPDGDD: first a short summary, then the full detail of GDPR article 13, section by section.

blocks.text: If you only have a minute, this is what matters most. For the full detail, keep reading or use the table of contents.

items.description: POR_COMPLETAR (see the "Who is the controller" section).
Personalizing your experience (theme and language), remembering your cookie decision, and answering your email if you write to us.
Your own action while using the interface, your consent when you write to us, and our obligation to be able to demonstrate your consent decision.
Netlify, as processor for technical hosting. There are no disclosures to third parties for commercial purposes.
Access, rectification, erasure, restriction, objection, and portability. See the "Your rights" section.

sections.heading: Who is the data controller (art. 13.1.a GDPR)

blocks.text: The controller responsible for processing your data is:
This identifying data is still pending from the site owner. Until it is provided, this page does not comply with GDPR article 13.1.a and should not be treated as a publishable privacy policy.
No Data Protection Officer (DPO) has been appointed.

Appointing one is not mandatory: none of the cases in GDPR article 37 apply (we are not a public authority, our activity does not involve regular and systematic large-scale monitoring of individuals, and we do not process special categories of data at scale), nor do any of the additional cases in article 34 of the Spanish LOPDGDD.

sections.heading: Purposes of processing and their legal basis (art. 13.1.c GDPR)

items.description: Legal basis: it is a feature you activate yourself by using the theme switch or the language selector (art. 6.1.f GDPR, legitimate interest in giving you the interface you chose; exempt from consent under art. 22.2 of the Spanish LSSI-CE, see the "What we store on your device" section).
Legal basis: necessary to be able to demonstrate that you made that decision (art. 7.1 GDPR).
Only if you write to us voluntarily. Legal basis: your consent, given when you send the email (art. 6.1.a GDPR).

blocks.text: The only processing that relies on legitimate interest (art. 6.1.f GDPR) is the interface personalization described above, and that interest is simply giving you back the preference you chose yourself. No other processing is based on the controller's legitimate interest.

items: Netlify, as processor, for the site's technical hosting (see the "Hosting" section).
POR_COMPLETAR: the email provider where messages you send through the contact form are received.

blocks.text: We do not disclose your data to third parties for commercial purposes, and we do not sell it.
The site is hosted on Netlify's infrastructure, which may involve transfers of technical data outside the European Economic Area.

POR_COMPLETAR: the specific safeguard that applies (for example, standard contractual clauses) has not yet been independently verified for this release. No specific safeguard is asserted here without having checked it.

sections.heading: How long we keep your data (art. 13.2.a GDPR)

items.description: Indefinitely, until you clear this site's data in your own browser. It does not expire on its own.
365 days from the moment you record it, or until the consent record's own version changes (whichever comes first). After that, you are asked again.
POR_COMPLETAR: how long your message is kept depends on the controller's internal policy, which is not yet defined.

blocks.text: You can exercise these rights over your data at any time:

items: Access: find out what data we process about you.
Erasure: ask us to delete your data.
Restriction: ask us to restrict its processing.
Objection: object to a specific processing activity.
Portability: receive your data in a structured, commonly used format.

blocks.text: To exercise them, write to POR_COMPLETAR stating which right you want to exercise.

You can change your cookie decision at any time, as many times as you like, by reopening the preferences panel from the "Cookie preferences" link in the footer. Withdrawing consent does not affect the lawfulness of processing carried out before the withdrawal.

sections.heading: How to complain to the supervisory authority (art. 13.2.d GDPR)

blocks.text: If you believe the processing of your data breaches the law, you can file a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Agency (AEPD), www.aepd.es, Calle Jorge Juan 6, 28001 Madrid, Spain.

sections.heading: Whether providing your data is mandatory or voluntary (art. 13.2.e GDPR)

blocks.text: Providing your email address in the contact form is entirely voluntary. If you do not provide it, the only consequence is that we will not be able to reply to you.
No automated decisions about you, including profiling, that produce legal effects or significantly affect you are made.

sections.heading: What we store on your device

blocks.text: This is the complete and only list of everything this site writes on your device. There are no HTTP cookies, analytics, or third-party scripts at this time.
The analytics we plan to add in the future is cookie-free (tools like Plausible or Umami, which write nothing on your device). It is not installed yet.

The site is a static export (no application server of our own) hosted on Netlify, which acts as processor for the technical hosting and processes technical request data (for example, IP addresses in its access logs) under its own privacy policy.

The contact form does not send any data to our servers: we have no server to send it to. When you press "send", your browser opens your own email application with the message already drafted, for you to send yourself from your own account if you choose to. The site receives and stores nothing from that form.
Once you decide to send the email, it reaches our inbox like any other email, and we process it solely to handle your request.
We may update this policy whenever the way we process your data changes. The date and version of the last substantive revision appear at the top of this document.

terms.intro: There is no Spanish law that sets the mandatory content of terms of use for a purely informational site like this one. This document lists the reasonable clauses that govern your use of the site, given that the site does not sell any product or service.

By browsing this site you accept these terms of use. If you do not agree with them, please do not continue browsing.

No license over them is granted beyond what is necessary to browse the site.

The site links to third-party platforms, such as GitHub and Discord, over which we have no control. We are not responsible for the content or practices of those sites; we recommend reviewing their own terms and privacy policy.

We make reasonable efforts to keep the site available, but we do not guarantee continuous, uninterrupted, or error-free access. We may temporarily suspend access for maintenance or for reasons beyond our control.

We try to keep the site's information accurate, but we do not guarantee its absolute accuracy or that it is permanently up to date. To the extent the law allows, we are not liable for damages arising from use of the site, except where they result from our own willful misconduct or gross negligence.

Where the other party is a consumer, the courts that the law reserves for their protection will have jurisdiction; we do not impose any specific court other than that, because article 90 of the consolidated text of the Spanish General Law for the Defense of Consumers and Users declares void and abusive any clause that submits a consumer to a jurisdiction other than that of their own domicile.

The site does not sell products or services, so the electronic contracting regime (arts. 23 to 29 of the Spanish LSSI-CE) and the pre-contractual information regime for consumers (arts. 97 and 98 of the consolidated text of the Spanish General Law for the Defense of Consumers and Users) do not apply.

accessibility.title: Accessibility statement
accessibility.description: VoidToInfinite's voluntary accessibility statement: scope, reference technical standard, compliance status, and remaining non-accessible content.
accessibility.intro: This statement is voluntary: Spanish Royal Decree 1112/2018 applies to the public sector, not to a private company like this one. Directive (EU) 2019/882 and Spanish Law 11/2023 have applied since 28 June 2025, but their article 2.2 lists a closed set of services that a presentation site without e-commerce does not fit into, and their article 4.5 also exempts microenterprises. This last reading is a reasoned interpretation of the law, not a certainty confirmed by any official ruling on this specific case.

blocks.text: This statement applies to the entire voidtoinfinite.com website, including this page and the other three legal pages.

We use standard EN 301 549 V3.2.1 (March 2021) as our reference, which incorporates the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1, level AA. Version V4.1.1 of the standard, which would incorporate WCAG 2.2 AA, is in progress with no confirmed publication date.
Our declared target is WCAG 2.2 AA, which is backward-compatible with WCAG 2.1 AA.

Partial compliance: the site meets most of the applicable criteria, but it has not undergone an independent third-party accessibility audit. Claiming full compliance without that audit would be a claim we cannot support.

What is verified and backed by the codebase's own automated tests: color contrast meets level AA on the measured color pairs, the site respects the reduced-motion preference (prefers-reduced-motion) throughout its whole animation system, there is a visible focus ring on every interactive control, and the interface controls (links, buttons, fields) are native, keyboard-navigable elements.
What has not yet been verified with a real browser or an external audit:

items: Color contrast at the intermediate points of animated gradients, beyond the specific values measured by calculation.
The site's behavior under the operating system's forced-colors mode.
The real experience of scroll-triggered content reveals with a screen reader and with a keyboard, beyond what the automated tests cover.

The site does not provide a skip-to-content link. The header on these legal pages has only three focusable elements and every document opens with a table of contents linking to all its sections, so the tabbing cost is low, but a skip link is still a standard aid that is missing here.
A full accessibility audit carried out by a person using a real screen reader or by an independent third party.

items.description: Self-assessment by our own team, supported by automated tests of the codebase.

blocks.text: If you find an accessibility barrier on this site, you can let us know by writing to POR_COMPLETAR.

Since we are not a body bound by Royal Decree 1112/2018, there is no formal complaints procedure required by that law for this site. As a voluntary channel, you can write to us at POR_COMPLETAR and we will address your feedback as soon as possible.
